## Context: data explosion

| Year | Global volume |
|-------|---------------|
| 2010 | 2 zettabytes |
| 2018 | 33 zettabytes |
| 2025 | ~181 zettabytes |

- **Zettabyte** (zetabyte) = $2^{70}$ bytes = 1 billion terabytes
- Growth **exponential**, not linear
- Causes : smartphones, social networks, IoT, streaming, digitisation

> YouTube: 30h/min Uploaded (2012) → 500h/min (2024) = ×15 in 10 years

## User requirements

- **Decision** (Decision Making) → requires relevant information
- **Informational avalanche** (Information Avalanche) → Cognitive overload
- **Access to large deposits** (Large Repositories) → Foundation of Data Science

### Information Management Pipeline

```
Documents bruts → Extraction de caractéristiques → Caractéristiques
→ Mapping approprié → Espace de représentation
→ Interaction utilisateur → Décision
```

### Three axes to structure raw data

- **Representation** (Document Representation): feature vector by document
- **Similarity** (Similarity Measurement): compare two documents
- **Analysis** (Analysis): mining, learning, visualization

---

## Examples of representation by media type

| Media | Feature extraction | Representation |
|-------|--------------------|----------------|
| Text | Word frequencies | TF vector, word cloud |
| Image | Colour Histogram (RGB) | 3D visual space |
| Audio | Spectral descriptors (MFCC) | Time vector |
| Video | Frames + audio | Multimodal |
| Web | Links, metadata | Hypertext Graph |

> Any object to which a **embedding** can be associated is processed by the IR

---

## Distance in IR

### Definition

> **Distance / Similarity** = mathematical formalization of the similarity between two documents

### Three roles of distance

| Role | What it measures |
|------|-------------------|
| Characterizing a document | Digital summary (features) |
| Compare two documents | Similarity / Patterns |
| Characterize a model | Overall structure of the corpus |

### Applications

- **Unsupervised Mining**: clustering, fault detection, imputation
- **Supervised Learning: Classification (k-NN), Regression, Ranking
- **Visualization**: dimension reduction (t-SNE, UMAP, PCA)

> The choice of distance measurement is **critical**: a bad measure = poor results even with good representation

---

## Definition of IR

> **Information Retrieval (IR)** = to bring out **automatically** information **relevant** from a **large collection of documents** via a **loose query**

### Keywords of the definition

- **Automatically** → without human intervention by query
- **Pertinent** → related to need, not just keywords
- **Large collection** → transition to scale (scalability)
- **Loose query** (Loose Query) → natural language, not formal

---

## History of the IR — Chronology

| Year | Event |
|-------|-----------|
| 1950 | Moors → term *Information Retrieval* |
| 1959 | Luhn → recovery **statistic** |
| 1960 | Maron & Kuhns → model **probabilistic** |
| 1966 | Cranfield Project → Evaluation** (precision, recall) |
| 1968 | Salton → system **SMART**, vector model |
| 1972 | DIALOG → first online commercial service |
| ~1990 | IR on PC, storage revolution |
| 1992 | Westlaw → Large-scale probabilistic IR |
| 1994 | Explosion of**Internet** |
| 1995 | IR **omnipresent** (Search button) |
| Today | **Embeddings** neurals (BERT, GPT...) |

## Course content — Overview

### Embeddings (Vector embeddings)

| Type | Methods |
|------|----------|
| **Low** (Spare) | TF·IDF, Vector Space Model, LSI |
| **Probabilistic** | BM25, Language Models |
| **Dense** (Dense) | Word2Vec, BERT, Sentence-BERT |
| **Ranking** | Learning to Rank (pointwise / pairwise / listwise) |

### Other modules

- **Indexing** (Indexing) → Inverted index, scalability
- **Evaluation** → Precision, Recall, F-measure, NDCG, MAP
- **IR Social** → Web IR, Recommendation, Network Analysis
- **Media specific** → Text, Image (CBIR), Audio
- **Visualization** → Manifold learning, t-SNE, UMAP

---

## Assessment measures — Notes

| Measure | Formula / Definition |
|--------|----------------------|
| Precision (Precision) | Relevant Docs returned / Docs returned |
| Recall (Recall) | Relevant Docs returned / Total relevant Docs |
| F-measure (F-Measure) | Average harmonic Precision + Recall |
| MAP | Precision average on several queries |
| NDCG | Cumulative gain taking into account **position** |

---

## Key relationships between concepts

```
Besoin informationnel (Information Need)
        ↓
   Requête (Query)
        ↓
Système IR [Collection indexée]
        ↓
Documents classés par pertinence (Ranked Results)
        ↓
   Utilisateur → Feedback → Système IR
```

---

## Critical Points / Traps

- More data does not mean better informed
- 
- Relevance is **for the user**, not absolute
- Dense embeddings capture **semantics**; the hollows capture the exact **terms**
- Strict evaluation (Cranfield, 1966) is essential for comparing systems
